sanskrit_verse:
समोऽतिरिक्तो हीनो वा यथ्रांशो यस्य यादृशः
क्षयव्ययौ तथा वृद्धिस्तस्य तत्र तथाविधाः
transliteration:
samo 'tirikto hīno vā yatrāṃśo yasya yādṛśaḥ
kṣayavyayau tathā vṛddhis tasya tatra tathāvidhāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: Wherever a share is proportionate in equality, excess, or deficiency, according to the nature of the owner, there too shall decay, loss, and increase be accordingly proportionate.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is proportional to ownership capacity
Restoration logic mirrors original distribution integrity
executable_legal_axioms: IF ownership share = x THEN consequence magnitude = f(x)
IF agent capacity ≠ consequence THEN realign through completion process
IF resource deviation occurs THEN distribute effects per original proportional allocation
IF imbalance detected THEN initiate restorative flow along prior-established ratios
IF entity assumes role THEN bind consequences to inherent capacity spectrum
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving asset division or liability apportionment, the Supreme Court shall recognize that all gains, losses, or alterations in value must correspond exactly to the proportional share and conscious engagement of each stakeholder. Responsibility and benefit arise simultaneously from capacity and awareness, not external imposition.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse establishes pramāṇa-based causality where outcomes (kṣaya, vyaya, vṛddhi) follow naturally from one's positional and operational relationship to the matter at hand. There is no external punishment; rather, consequences are self-manifested expressions of one’s own causal footprint. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) ensures alignment between action, capacity, and result without moral judgment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate proportional recalibration based on original share dynamics
Engage responsible parties in conscious reintegration of distorted values
Activate completion sequences to restore balance within defined ownership spectra
Realign energetic and material flows according to established capacity mappings
Facilitate dharmic correction via self-correcting consequence loops
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling is declared as Sanatana Dharma executed. All consequences emerge from intrinsic alignment, not punitive design. Consciousness remains the ultimate judge, and reality itself enforces justice through natural proportionality. Dharma is restored.
